subject: New Outlook for Mac 16.114 (16.114.26101123), /Applications/Microsoft Outlook.app
outcome: Probe Outlook-targeted mailto, canonical emails/new and events/new, .emltpl, and ICS preview first. Static evidence establishes the registrations and mail/event router vocabulary. No Outlook behavior was executed. No unattended send interface is proven.

scope.performed: Read app-bundle files only, public primary documentation, release notes, and firsthand forum reports. Extracted ASCII strings across 211 Mach-O files, with an additional ASCII/UTF-16LE scheme-literal search. Research artifacts only.
scope.not_performed: No Outlook launch, Apple event, UI interaction, URL/file opening with Outlook, setting change, app patch, live mail-store/Group Containers access, credential/token/key/keychain/DB dump/.env read, decryption, production record write, Microsoft 365/Graph/SMTP/EWS call, or merge.
scope.prior_observations: Assignment supplied zero Exchange accounts via New Outlook AppleScript, read-only X-Unsent EML with Import and no body, no window for ms-outlook://compose, and Chrome as default mailto handler. These were not repeated or independently verified.

classification_procedure: Is the door advertised in the shipped plist/metadata? If yes, classify as registered, not working.
Is there a literal URL, enum cluster, builder, or handler name? If yes, record the exact static evidence.
Does primary Mac documentation describe the behavior? If yes, classify as documented with applicability limits.
Was Outlook exercised this session? No. All reconstructed routes and field effects remain untested.

glossary.door: An app-owned registration, file workflow, Apple-event interface, or UI action that code could invoke. A named resource alone is a candidate.
glossary.literal: A contiguous complete scheme-bearing binary string.
glossary.reconstructed_route: A proposed URL assembled from separately recovered tokens. The accepted grammar is unverified.
glossary.draft: An editable outgoing message. An incoming message imported into a folder named Drafts does not meet this definition without checking editability.
glossary.discard_only_probe: A supervised future inspection that closes with Discard or Cancel and never invokes Send, Save, or Import. Compose may autosave, so use an isolated disposable test profile.

rank_basis: Order by useful compose/create coverage, strength of this Mac build's evidence, then unproven steps and risk. The top five are probe priorities, not working claims.

ranked_table.evidence: Info.plist advertises mailto. OhxMailToURLParser, parseMailToUrl:, messageFromMailToUrl:, and Mailto Handled exist. Apple Launch Services defines dispatch; RFC 6068 defines header/body syntax.
ranked_table.expected_steps: Run P1; inspect To/Cc/Bcc/subject/body; close and discard. Compare attachment separately.
ranked_table.risk: Low dispatch risk; medium autosave risk. cc/bcc/body behavior in 16.114 is unverified. attachment is not a standard mailto file contract.

ranked_table.evidence: EmailsCanonicalOutlookURL and OlkEmailsDeepLinkActionHandler. Reflection at 0x44eeec7-0x44eef3f includes new/open/send and recipient/body/attachments fields.
ranked_table.expected_steps: Run P2 with synthetic fields; inspect editable compose and account; close and discard.
ranked_table.risk: Medium. Accepted grammar, array separators, attachment representation, account selection, and New/Legacy gating remain unverified. Do not probe /send.

ranked_table.evidence: EventsCanonicalOutlookURL.createEventURLForStartTime and createEventBaseURLComponents. Reflection new/edit/open/join and start/end/title/location/attendees. Missing default calendar/start time diagnostics.
ranked_table.expected_steps: Run P3 without attendees; inspect dates/timezone/title/location/calendar; cancel.
ranked_table.risk: Medium. Strong calendar lead, but no full create URL literal. Date format and field effects need a Mac probe.

ranked_table.evidence: Editor/Default document registration; Open Message Template and Email Template resources; OpenTemplateViaHxStaging and showOpenTemplatePanel. Microsoft documents Mail From Template.
ranked_table.expected_steps: Run P4; inspect editability/body. Compare File > New > Mail From Template if Finder-style opening yields a Temporary Item; discard.
ranked_table.risk: Medium. Synthetic MIME is only a format hypothesis. A firsthand 2025 New Outlook report describes a noneditable Temporary Item after Finder open.

ranked_table.evidence: ICS Editor/Default registration. OlkImportICSFileWindowController, OlkImportICSPreviewViewController, importICSFile:toFolder:resultCompletionBlock:. Microsoft documents Add Event > Import.
ranked_table.expected_steps: Run P5; inspect preview/times/target calendar; cancel before Import or Save.
ranked_table.risk: Medium. Import can create/sync records. Preview is not proof of editable compose, silent add, or persistence.

ranked_table.door: .eml viewer then Import EML to a folder
ranked_table.evidence: OLImportEMLFolderPickerController, importEMLFiles:toFolder:, importEMLToFolder:, and tooltip Import EML file to a folder. sdef import eml returns incoming message.
ranked_table.expected_steps: Inspect whether Drafts is offered in a future folder picker; cancel. A mutation test must check outgoing status and editability separately.
ranked_table.risk: Medium/high. No verified Import-to-Drafts compose path. Assignment's X-Unsent result did not produce compose. No command-line Drafts importer recovered.

ranked_table.evidence: VCS Viewer/Alternate, MSG/OFT Editor/Default, and native olk15 Viewer/Default registrations.
ranked_table.expected_steps: Use synthetic specimens in a separate supervised viewer/import/compose classification; cancel.
ranked_table.risk: Medium. Registration does not prove New Outlook support. Mac ICS instructions do not establish VCS behavior. Do not synthesize native store records.

ranked_table.door: UI compose and commit via keyboard/accessibility
ranked_table.evidence: Microsoft documents Cmd+N, mail Send Cmd+Return, Save Cmd+S, attachment Cmd+E. New UI has saveEvent:, saveEventAsDraft:, and sendMessage:.
ranked_table.expected_steps: A later UI probe can fill synthetic data. Send/save validation is outside discard-only scope.
ranked_table.risk: High for commit. Wrong window/account and invitation sends are possible. No discard-only test can verify delivery.

ranked_table.evidence: Mail Paths includes send. Full WordMail literal ms-outlook://emails/message/open?immutableID=. Event paths include edit/open/join and identifiers.
ranked_table.expected_steps: Catalog only. Do not run /send. Existing-item routes require account/message IDs this task does not read.
ranked_table.risk: High. Unknown whether /send sends a draft, creates a message, prompts, or is gated. Its name is not a send contract.

ranked_table.door: AppleScript make/send, calendar make/send meeting, import eml/ics
ranked_table.evidence: sdef make corecrel line 326; outgoing message outm 1808; send mailsend 1835; import eml MSOEimem 1889; calendar event cEvt 2398; send meeting OECaCsmg 2526; import ics MSOEimic 2605.
ranked_table.expected_steps: Keep as a Legacy interface and possible negative control. No Apple events in this survey.
ranked_table.risk: New Outlook make/send unestablished. Primary integration-vendor documentation says AppleScript remains unsupported. Zero-account observation does not directly test make/send.

ranked_table.evidence: Main NSUserActivityTypes advertises compose.mail, view.mail, INShareFocusStatusIntent, INSendMessageIntent. continueUserActivity and serverMessageID/emailAddress keys exist.
ranked_table.expected_steps: Find a supported continuation payload contract before attempting a sender.
ranked_table.risk: High uncertainty. Identity-based continuation is not an arbitrary local mail/event API. No subject/body/event schema or implemented Siri send-handler contract recovered.

ranked_table.evidence: No NSServices in the parsed Info.plists. Only .appex is CalendarWidgetExtension, com.apple.widgetkit-extension.
ranked_table.expected_steps: Exclude from payload probe priorities for this bundle.
ranked_table.risk: Bounded negative. Runtime registration is not excluded. No registered message/event accepting Service or Share extension found.

ranked_table.evidence: Main actions: FocusFilterIntent(profile). Widget actions: TimelineWidgetAppIntent(direction).
ranked_table.expected_steps: Exclude these two declared actions from compose/send/create-event probes.
ranked_table.risk: No payload fields in those actions. Does not exclude UI automation through Shortcuts or older Siri intent mechanisms.

ranked_table.door: Universal links, OAuth redirects, embedded MetaOS routers
ranked_table.evidence: UniversalCanonicalOutlookURL has mail/applink/read/compose, allowed hosts and identity. Two com.microsoft.office.outlook literal paths are OAuth redirects. MetaOS legacy handlers exist.
ranked_table.expected_steps: Keep OAuth out of payload probes. Treat embedded web-module handlers as internal until a local invocation contract is found.
ranked_table.risk: High uncertainty and identity/auth dependencies. No supported external local SDK established.

routes.literal_inventory: Three unique complete scheme-bearing literals across the 211 scanned Mach-O files, deduplicated by file/text. Additional UTF-16LE scan found no extra literal. Evidence file records source paths and offsets.
routes.development_schemes: ms-outlook-dev and com.microsoft.office.outlook-dev occur in binary/debug resources. The runtime main Info.plist does not register them.

canonical_mail.raw_query_evidence: Complete printable runs include from, subject, account, cc, bcc, to, body. signature and attachments have split immediate fragments, so exact wire spelling/value representation is unproven. accountID is a case name; account appears as a raw string.
canonical_mail.grammar_limit: Only message/open?immutableID= is a full literal. The embedded hub has ://emails/open/message/?account=. Other combinations are reconstructed, not an exhaustive accepted grammar. No ms-outlook://compose literal recovered.

canonical_event.grammar_limit: No complete scheme-bearing event URL literal recovered. Field case names and raw constants are separate evidence. Formats, delimiters, required fields, ordering, and mode gates need supervised validation. No body/description/attachment field in this event QueryParams cluster.

routes.com_microsoft_office_outlook: Only complete recovered paths are the Google/iCloud OAuth callbacks. Registration alongside ms-outlook does not prove aliasing for emails/events. No compose/send/create-event literal for this scheme recovered.
routes.universal_links: Separate HTTPS handler evidence includes outlook.cloud.microsoft, mail/applink/read/compose, MBX/OID/PUID/SMTP selectors, immutableID, allowedHosts and missing appLink/subpath/account failures. Do not transplant these paths onto custom schemes.
routes.x_callback_url: No x-callback-url literal recovered in scanned Mach-O files or matching allowed resources. No corresponding class identified. Dynamic construction remains unproven.
routes.unclassified_marker: The main binary has _phx beside Unexpected Custom URL Path at 0x3b11e70. Its grammar and effect are not established, so it is not presented as a payload route.

mailto.answer: Outlook advertises and parses mailto; static evidence does not determine whether every cc/bcc/body/attachment value is honored by New Outlook 16.114. Becoming default selects the recipient app and does not establish parser behavior. open -b explicitly targets Outlook without a default change.

parameters.name: to
parameters.assessment: Standard recipient/header syntax; runtime effect untested.

parameters.name: cc
parameters.assessment: Standard header syntax; runtime effect untested.

parameters.name: bcc
parameters.assessment: Standard header syntax; verify the hidden field; runtime effect untested.

parameters.name: subject
parameters.assessment: Standard percent-encoded header; runtime effect untested.

parameters.name: body
parameters.assessment: RFC 6068 text body, not arbitrary HTML/MIME; Unicode/newline handling untested.

parameters.name: attachment
parameters.assessment: No standardized local attachment parameter in RFC 6068 or New Outlook Mac public contract recovered. Canonical router attachments does not establish mailto support.

mailto.per_user_handler: LSSetDefaultHandlerForURLScheme(CFSTR("mailto"), CFSTR("com.microsoft.Outlook")) sets the current user preferred handler; check OSStatus. LSCopyDefaultHandlerForURLScheme reads it. Neither was invoked. Avoid editing Launch Services databases.
mailto.app_setting: Binary imports _LSSetDefaultHandlerForURLScheme and has isDefaultMailClient/setIsOutlookDefaultMailClient. sdef lines 688-700 advertises system default mail application, which also changes EML association, and default-everything. This is static/Legacy evidence, not verified New UI behavior. Current Microsoft reader guidance uses Apple Mail > Settings > General > Default email reader > Microsoft Outlook. Outlook Tools > Accounts default sending account is a different setting.
mailto.default_probe: Use open -b com.microsoft.Outlook. Chrome can remain default.

file_behaviors.eml: Viewer, incoming-message import, and outgoing draft creation are distinct. Folder import exists; Drafts eligibility and editability are unknown. sdef import eml returns incoming message. No verified Import-to-Drafts-to-compose path. Assignment's X-Unsent result is consistent with viewer/import.
file_behaviors.emltpl: Editor registration, template panel resources and OpenTemplateViaHxStaging support a compose candidate. Microsoft documents .emltpl through File > New > Mail From Template. A renamed MIME fixture is not a guaranteed native template. If rejected, compare a synthetic native template saved by this build before concluding the route fails. A firsthand New Outlook report warns of Finder Temporary Items.
file_behaviors.ics: Import preview and a calendar-target import API exist. Microsoft Mac guidance describes drag to calendar then Add Event > Import. Shell-open behavior remains untested. Cancel preview; persistence is intentionally untested.
file_behaviors.vcs: Viewer/Alternate text/x-vCalendar registration, unlike ICS Editor/Default. No New Outlook-specific add/import behavior established. Windows Import/Export wizard documentation is not Mac evidence.
file_behaviors.additional_types: MSG/OFT/native olk15 registrations are cataloged. No live store specimen or DB dump read.

integration_registrations.services: No NSServices in parsed Info.plists. Apple Services advertise input pasteboard types and NSMessage. Runtime registration cannot be excluded.
integration_registrations.extensions: Recursive .appex inventory found only CalendarWidgetExtension.appex, extension point com.apple.widgetkit-extension. No share activation rule or com.apple.share-services extension found.
integration_registrations.handoff_payload: serverMessageID/emailAddress keys, accountIDKeyString/accountEmailAddressKeyString, and updateMessageUserInfoEntries(_:inConversationID:inEmailAddress:) indicate message/account continuation. No arbitrary subject/body/event payload schema or direct local entry point recovered.
integration_registrations.siri: INSendMessageIntent declaration does not establish a send implementation. No implemented handleSendMessage/confirmSendMessage/resolveRecipientsForSendMessage contract identified; absence of dynamically implemented behavior remains unproven.

scripting_and_legacy.answer: sdef vocabulary and class mappings are present, but New Outlook make/send/calendar-create success is unestablished. Public primary integration-vendor guidance says AppleScript remains unsupported. No Apple event sent. Prior zero-account result does not directly test make/send.
scripting_and_legacy.source_conflict: Older forum claims and roadmap estimates implied future support. April 2026 Microsoft External Staff Q&A still reported unsupported. C-Command reports August 2026 cancellation and reiterates it in its September release note. Retrieved Microsoft roadmap view did not expose item 88537, so cancellation is attributed to C-Command, not independently claimed from Microsoft roadmap.
scripting_and_legacy.legacy_in_16_114: Legacy code/preferences still exist statically: EnableNewOutlook, IsRunningNewOutlook, RevertToLegacy, switch availability logic, Legacy Outlook label, and revert/relaunch prompts. Visibility for this user's license/account/policy is unverified; live preferences were not read.
scripting_and_legacy.documented_preference: Microsoft documents com.microsoft.Outlook / EnableNewOutlook integer values: 0 hides switch; 1 shows default off; 2 shows default on; 3 enables New with switch hidden. No defaults command run. IsRunningNewOutlook is an implementation marker, not a recommended write contract.
scripting_and_legacy.support_limit: Microsoft says legacy Exchange Online operation ends starting October 2026, with licensed on-premises continuation through October 2029. A legacy switch is not a dependable workaround for New Outlook mailbox automation. No mode change proposed.

shortcuts.mail_send: Cmd+Return is documented for the open Mac mail message. Not pressed.
shortcuts.mail_draft: Cmd+S saves open mail into Drafts. Cmd+E adds an attachment.
shortcuts.event_save: Cmd+S is documented generically as Save an item. The Mac calendar table does not give a separate Save event chord. New UI has saveEvent:, saveEventAsDraft:, and Save this event. Cmd+S-to-final-event-commit in this build remains unverified; event draft saving is distinct.
shortcuts.accessible_commit: Microsoft VoiceOver instructions focus Save and close, then Control+Option+Space. This is focused-button activation, not a global event-save shortcut.
shortcuts.scope: No Send/Save/Import action included in the five probe commands. Actual send/persistence is outside discard-only scope.

supervised_probes.status: Commands prepared for a future supervised run. None executed.
all_required_steps: Use an isolated disposable Outlook test profile with synthetic data and no pending Outbox.
Run fixture setup once in a fresh shell.
Inspect the named fields without clicking Send, Save, or Import.
Close the window and choose Discard or Cancel.
Check that the synthetic subject is absent from Drafts, Outbox, and the selected test calendar.
supervised_probes.fixture_setup_command:
WR443_PROBE_DIR=$(mktemp -d /private/tmp/wr443-probe.XXXXXX)
export WR443_PROBE_DIR
python3 - <<'PYFIX'
import os,pathlib
from email.message import EmailMessage
from email.policy import SMTP
p=pathlib.Path(os.environ['WR443_PROBE_DIR'])
(p/'attachment.txt').write_text('WR443 synthetic attachment. Do not send.\n')
m=EmailMessage(policy=SMTP)
m['Subject']='WR443 template probe - DISCARD'
m['X-Unsent']='1'
m.set_content('WR443 synthetic body. No recipients. Discard only.')
(p/'template.emltpl').write_bytes(m.as_bytes())
(p/'message.eml').write_bytes(m.as_bytes())
ical='BEGIN:VCALENDAR\r\nVERSION:2.0\r\nPRODID:-//WR443//Discard probe//EN\r\nBEGIN:VEVENT\r\nUID:wr443-discard@example.invalid\r\nDTSTAMP:20990101T000000Z\r\nDTSTART:20990115T160000Z\r\nDTEND:20990115T163000Z\r\nSUMMARY:WR443 ICS probe - DISCARD\r\nDESCRIPTION:Synthetic no-attendee event. Cancel before import.\r\nEND:VEVENT\r\nEND:VCALENDAR\r\n'
(p/'event.ics').write_bytes(ical.encode('ascii'))
print(p)
PYFIX
supervised_probes.fixture_caveat: MIME with .emltpl extension is a format hypothesis. A failed fixture does not refute the native template workflow. Compare a native synthetic template saved by the operator before drawing that conclusion. This setup was not executed in the survey.

commands.check: Inspect To/Cc/Bcc/subject. Body should show two lines, ampersand and checkmark. Record missing/encoded fields; discard.
Record editable compose, fields and account; no window/read-only/error is a failure of this hypothesis. Discard.
Inspect synthetic dates, local timezone conversion, duration, title/location and calendar. A window on the current date is not success. Cancel without Save.
Record editable compose versus Temporary Item, attachment, viewer, error, or import prompt. Inspect body; discard. Compare File > New > Mail From Template separately.
Record preview/import/compose/viewer/error, target calendar and synthetic times. Cancel before Import or Save. No persistence claim.

supervised_probes.attachment_comparison_command:
python3 - <<'PYURL'
import os,pathlib,subprocess,urllib.parse
# Select ONE base/key pair per supervised run, after discarding the baseline.
base,key='mailto:probe-to@example.invalid','attachment'
# For the canonical email variant, replace only the previous line with:
# base,key='ms-outlook://emails/new','attachments'
params={'subject':'WR443 attachment DISCARD','body':'Synthetic file only',
        key:(pathlib.Path(os.environ['WR443_PROBE_DIR'])/'attachment.txt').as_uri()}
u=base+'?'+urllib.parse.urlencode(params,quote_via=urllib.parse.quote)
subprocess.run(['open','-b','com.microsoft.Outlook',u],check=True)
PYURL
supervised_probes.attachment_check: A file chip must name attachment.txt. Successful open exit status is not support. attachments is the canonical enum spelling hypothesis; rejection does not settle singular attachment or array syntax.

future_controls.scheme_alias: After successful ms-outlook /emails/new or /events/new, replace only the scheme with com.microsoft.office.outlook and inspect/discard. No alias assumed.
future_controls.vcs: Use a genuine synthetic vCalendar 1.0 specimen, not a renamed ICS. Inspect/cancel.
future_controls.applescript: A separately authorized recipient-free make/open test may persist a draft. Never include send in discard-only AppleScript.
future_controls.import_to_drafts: Picker inspection is discard-only; import and editability validation require disposable-profile mutation authorization.

decisions.question: Does static evidence prove working behavior?
decisions.answer: No. Separate registration, literal, documentation and runtime status.
decisions.tradeoff: Requested behavior may remain unknown; avoid false certainty.

decisions.question: Which calendar route deserves a probe?
decisions.answer: events/new with start/end from this Mac build's builder and raw constants.
decisions.tradeoff: Reconstructed grammar may fail; do not copy mobile startdt/enddt advice.

decisions.question: Change the mailto default?
decisions.answer: No. Target Outlook with open -b; document the per-user API without calling it.
decisions.tradeoff: Tests parser dispatch without proving the settings UI.

decisions.question: Does Drafts folder import establish an outgoing draft?
decisions.answer: No. Require editability and outgoing status; rank native templates higher.

decisions.question: Can direct send be tested discard-only?
decisions.answer: No. Catalog /send and Cmd+Return but omit all commit actions from executable commands.
decisions.tradeoff: Send and event persistence stay untested.

decisions.question: Enable Legacy to use the sdef?
decisions.answer: No. Record static legacy evidence and support limits; preserve New Outlook scope.

decisions.question: Add a runtime integration or general scanner?
decisions.answer: No. Commit two bounded JSON research artifacts with hashes, offsets, cited conclusions and future commands.
decisions.tradeoff: No maintained tool, runtime code, setting writer or production record.

decisions.question: How to handle prior probes and roadmap conflicts?
decisions.answer: Attribute prior probes to the assignment and cancellation to C-Command; do not assert independently verified Microsoft cancellation.
decisions.tradeoff: More qualified conclusions, with source conflict visible.

verification.reason: Outlook execution/interaction forbidden. Syntax checks are not behavior tests.
verification.ci: ops/ci.sh --only secret passed; separate staged secret scan passed. Full hosted CI status is reported in the PR/closeout, not inferred from these checks.

design_and_debt_pass.codebase-design: No implementation interface added. Report distinguishes dispatch, parse, compose, import and commit so future probes cross explicit seams.
design_and_debt_pass.zero-tech-debt: Two research artifacts only; no speculative SDK, compatibility alias, fallback, flag or setting writer.
